prompt: Two or three small rectangular sheets of paper floating on the open sea, their edges soaked and slightly sunk into the water, seen from slightly above, spread in a small loose fan; together they take no more than one fifth of the image width. The top sheet has a thick bold border of saturated violet #7C5CD6 and a large violet #7C5CD6 check mark on it. Small ripples drawn as lines around the sheets. Every wave is drawn as visible engraved line work, like a steel engraving, never painted, never smooth. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No realistic objects, no photographic rendering, no glow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no horizon, no sky, no clouds, full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, the sheets small in the upper right third, open water everywhere else. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and a touch of saturated violet #7C5CD6 on the top sheet only.
